name: print-social-navy-and-white-coaching-post-set-with-cyan-loops
title: Twelve navy, white and black coaching posts with giant stats, cyan hand-drawn loops and dot texture
whatItIs: A 4x3 grid of square posts for a business-coaching brand: white posts with big black statements, navy posts with giant '10x', '275%', '180%' numerals, a black event card, a portrait card, cyan hand-drawn loops around key words and a thin navy line meandering between cards, all with a small logo mark.
whatItMeans: Confident and credible; giant numbers and cyan loops give warmth to a formal palette.
techniques: Circle a key word with a cyan loop.
Draw one continuous navy line across the grid.

vocabulary.definition: A hand-drawn ring around a word.
A faint dot pattern in the background.
A post built around one number.
